title: Ramadan Mubarak
excerpt: In an era of misinformation and prejudice, would you like to understand more about Islam and Ramadan? Here’s a good primer from the good folks at the Raven Foundation: http://www.ravenfoundation.org/resources/islam-101/ramadan-the-god-of-the-marginalized
body:
